(A) THE `cancelled` TERMINAL: rules/schema/vocab.json eventTypes += cancelled; append! records it with a REQUIRED reason (a non-blank `reason` field, refused fail-closed in the store's validateEventShape — one enforcement point, so any writer/future cancel! inherits it) and stamps the initiator's provenance (RECORDED_BY) as the record note; ANY initiator may cancel — append-style bookkeeping, never a gate decision. store.taskStatus derives `cancelled` TERMINAL IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: the case never overrides done/failed, and the undecided-submission / undischarged-`waiting` blocked re-derivations now join the guard (`status !== done && !== failed && !== cancelled`), so a task cancelled while stuck at an undecided submission STAYS cancelled — today's only escape from a blocked task. Queued, active and blocked tasks can all be cancelled. CLOSED-SET PARITY via one exported CLOSED_TASK_STATUSES = [done, superseded, cancelled], consumed by: legStatus (the leg-done aggregate + the frontmost-child filter, so a cancelled child never reports the leg as `cancelled`), legGateMet (a cancelled task never holds the next leg's gate shut), the goal's structural exhaustion (goal/undo + the undecided-submission sweep, which now skips cancelled tasks), activeLeg, advance()'s closed count, the distance-to-goal rule, and the dogfood K1 read — which now READS vocab.statuses instead of hardcoding a second range list. (B) THE HONEST-STATUS GAP — word chosen: `accepted`, over `concluded`. A task whose confirm-result gate is ACCEPTED with no later `completed` derived `queued` (taskStatus had no `confirmed` case, so it fell through to the created default) and therefore looked RE-RUNNABLE to next/advance!/run!. `accepted` names exactly the state: the gate decision the human recorded (accept), with delivery not yet recorded. `concluded` was rejected because it collides with the repo's existing conclusion vocabulary — F-AC18 'conclusion' IS a completed task carrying structured commit evidence — and it would imply the very evidence that is missing. It is honest in all three directions: distinct from done (delivered), cancelled and failed; never runnable (frontmostReady/advance/lookBack filter on queued|active); and it yields to the two-phase wait (confirm accepted + an undischarged `waiting` still derives blocked — the empty-chain verify-wait is unchanged). The GRILL gate's confirmation is NOT this state: a grilled-but-unstarted task stays queued work. Leg 08 task 02 (NOT this task's scope) will later decide whether gate! confirm accept should auto-complete; this word is the honest derivation of the CURRENT model.
